All items supplied shall strictly conform to the specifications, standards an d requirements prescribed in the bid.

Items supplied shall be new, unused and of standard quality. Medicines/drugs supplied shall have a minimum 75% remaining shelf lif e or 18 months validity, whichever is higher, at the time of delivery, wherever applicable. The Buyer reserves the right to reject any item that does not conform to t he prescribed specifications, quality standards, quantity, documentati on or other terms and conditions of the bid. 8. Replacement of Rejected/Defective Items. Any item found to be defective, damaged, substandard, short-dated or n ot conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the su pplier within 07 days of receipt of intimation from the Buyer , at no additio nal cost to the Buyer. In the event of failure by the supplier to deliver the items within the stipulated d

elivery period, Liquidated Damages may be imposed at the rate of 0.5% per week of the delayed supply, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total order value, in accordance with applicable GeM/Government provisions. 10. The Buyer reserves the right to reject non-responsive bids or non-conformi ng supplies and to cancel/terminate the bid/order/contract in accordan ce with applicable GeM and Government rules, wherever warranted, includ ing in the interest of patient care, uninterrupted availability of essential items a nd smooth functioning of the hospital. .
